layout.bin_edges_source: 51-bin quantile edges of log1p(anchor CP10K) over the 2721 read-out genes of hepg2, fixed for every query
layout.tile_note: every pass carries the same highest-expression prefix; when the perturbed gene is not already in a pass it is appended to it, so the context differs between queries by exactly one gene

sign_convention: perturbed minus baseline; a positive entry means raising the perturbed gene raises the model's prediction for the read-out gene. Zero-out uses this convention, not the paper's reversed one
expression_floor_note: the read-out set is the inclusive floor; each gene's pooled control level travels with the block so a higher floor is a column mask
gene_embedding_source: TransformerModel.encoder.embedding, the gene token embedding table

mask_spec.source: scGPT args.json: mask_value and mask_ratio; the mildest pretraining rate is used

uniform_virtual.description: every supplied gene pinned at 3.6751 CP10K, the uniform share of a 10,000-count virtual cell; the paper's construction, and far off the distribution the models were trained on

mean_control.description: the pooled non-targeting control mean expression profile of this cell line, restricted to the read-out genes; the on-distribution counterpart

individual_cells.description: 4 real non-targeting control cells, each converted to CP10K so every anchor sits at one depth; responses are averaged over the cells and their spread is recorded
individual_cells.per_cell_spread: responses averaged over cells; see summary rows

substitutions: flash-attention not installed (the published checkpoint was trained with scGPT's FlashMHA layers, whose API exists only in flash-attn 1.x, which cannot build against this torch); used scGPT's own fallback torch.nn.TransformerEncoder path (use_fast_transformer=False), which changes the attention kernel and therefore the exact numerics

remapped 24 fused attention tensors from the checkpoint's FlashMHA layout (self_attn.Wqkv) onto torch's packed projection (self_attn.in_proj); both hold [query; key; value] over the same head partition, so the attention computed is the same function of the same weights. Verified numerically at load time (see attention_remap_check)
imported scgpt.model.model by file path to avoid executing scgpt/__init__ (scvi-tools / torchtext / scib); model source unmodified

contract.input_normalization: counts -> CP10K -> log1p -> per-cell quantile binning into 51 bins (published path). Gene tokens are vocab.json ids; no <cls> token is prepended (the checkpoint was trained with no_cls=True).
contract.output_head: ExprDecoder.fc -> dict['pred'], one scalar per gene token
contract.output_semantics: predicted binned expression value for that gene in this cell, on the 51-bin training scale (not counts, not CP10K)
contract.information_flow: bidirectional full attention over gene tokens; no positional encoding over genes
contract.symmetry_evidence: architecture imposes no ordering, so a response exists for every ordered pair, but symmetry of the pairwise response is not implied and was not measured here
substitutions: flash-attention not installed (the published checkpoint was trained with scGPT's FlashMHA layers, whose API exists only in flash-attn 1.x, which cannot build against this torch); used scGPT's own fallback torch.nn.TransformerEncoder path (use_fast_transformer=False), which changes the attention kernel and therefore the exact numerics

remapped 24 fused attention tensors from the checkpoint's FlashMHA layout (self_attn.Wqkv) onto torch's packed projection (self_attn.in_proj); both hold [query; key; value] over the same head partition, so the attention computed is the same function of the same weights. Verified numerically at load time (see attention_remap_check)
imported scgpt.model.model by file path to avoid executing scgpt/__init__ (scvi-tools / torchtext / scib); model source unmodified
contract.notes: The published input path bins expression with np.digitize, which has zero derivative almost everywhere: the Jacobian is therefore taken through a piecewise-linear surrogate of the same quantile bin edges. binning_deviation records how far the surrogate moves the output. Checkpoint build flags inferred from the state dict: {'do_mvc': True, 'explicit_zero_prob': False, 'use_batch_labels': False, 'has_dsbn': False}. Sequence length used here is the number of resolved vocabulary genes, which exceeds the training max_seq_len of 1200; scGPT has no positional encoding over genes, so this is a context-length extrapolation rather than an invalid input.

uniform_virtual.rule: smallest step whose column agrees with the next larger step at median Pearson >= 0.999 and median relative L2 difference <= 0.1; if none qualifies the step with the best direction agreement is used and the block is flagged

mean_control.rule: smallest step whose column agrees with the next larger step at median Pearson >= 0.999 and median relative L2 difference <= 0.1; if none qualifies the step with the best direction agreement is used and the block is flagged

individual_cells.rule: smallest step whose column agrees with the next larger step at median Pearson >= 0.999 and median relative L2 difference <= 0.1; if none qualifies the step with the best direction agreement is used and the block is flagged

uniform_virtual.sign_check_note: fraction whose own predicted output RISES when its input rises; a model that reverts to a population level can fail this while still being correctly wired
uniform_virtual.magnitude_check_note: fraction whose own entry is the largest response in the vector; this is the wiring guard
uniform_virtual.permutation_note: the same test after shuffling the read-out gene order; it must collapse to chance for the guard to have power

mean_control.sign_check_note: fraction whose own predicted output RISES when its input rises; a model that reverts to a population level can fail this while still being correctly wired

mask_spec.source: scGPT args.json: mask_value and mask_ratio; the mildest pretraining rate is used

masked.note: responses are read only at masked positions, averaged over cycles; the unmasked block at the same anchor is the comparison

context_comparison.form: zero-out response difference at the mean control anchor

untiled_exact_check.layout: readout (untiled), the layout that admits forward-mode autodiff

coverage.selection_rule: stratified sample of 250 at seed 42, 125 per stratum, drawn from the in-scope set; the individual-cell and masked subsets are nested inside it
coverage.in_scope_definition: perturbations in strata S3, S4_highest whose target gene is also a read-out gene of this cell line, so it can be perturbed at all
coverage.comparability_note: a block at partial coverage and a block at full coverage share the perturbed genes of the smaller one but not its row order; join on perturbed_gene_id, never on row index, and do not compare a per-block aggregate across two different coverages
coverage.annotated_after_extraction: added by features.annotate_coverage: the block was extracted before the coverage record existed. The selector was re-run and reproduces this block's perturbed table exactly, so the record describes the features as shipped; no array changed.

superseded_by.note: this 250-gene block is kept for provenance; the canonical block for scgpt / hepg2 covers every in-scope perturbation. Read feature_index/blocks.json rather than globbing the feature tree, and join on perturbed_gene_id, never on row index: the two coverages share genes but not row order.
